dossier.summary: Tallis Staffing places temporary and contract workers with warehouses and light manufacturers. It runs branches in nine cities and pays its workers every week.
dossier.why_now: Opened its ninth branch last month.

reasons.team: We assumed about 1 in 35 of the 1,001 to 5,000 people check and fix timesheets by hand, mostly branch coordinators and payroll staff.
reasons.hours: Chasing missing hours, correcting entries and re-sending approvals. We assumed 7 hours a week each.
reasons.rate: Pay for a branch coordinator plus benefits and overhead, in US dollars. Change it if your blended cost is different.
reasons.tools: Timesheet software seats, a payroll add-on and shared trackers across nine branches. You will know the actual figure.
